companies.note: Marketing is owned by a VP, not a CMO: Chris Churilo is named as the company media contact on every groundcover press release from Oct 2025 through May 2026. No public sales/revenue officer — the sponsorship route is Churilo, with Azulay as cheque signer after the $100M Series C (Jul 2026).

people.name: Chris Churilo
people.note: The buyer. Named as groundcover's media contact (chris.churilo@groundcover.com) on company-issued releases from Oct 2025 to May 2026 — owns brand and demand gen for a company that has just raised to build a Datadog challenger.

people.name: Shahar Azulay
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still CEO — quoted as co-founder & CEO in the July 2026 Series C release ($100M at a ~$500M valuation).

people.name: Yechezkel Rabinovich
people.note: Technical counterpart for any telemetry/observability workstream with a race team; ex-cyber unit, Israeli PM's Office, with Azulay.

companies.note: Full C-suite published on the company group team page. Marketing sits with a DACH-scoped CMO; a group-level 'Chief Marketing Officer (m/w/d)' req was also live on the company's join.com board, so the seat may be widening from DACH to group — worth re-checking before an approach.

people.name: Sophia Rödiger
people.note: The buyer for a Europe-facing FE programme. In seat since Aug 2023; profiled on 1KOMMA5°'s own magazine and speaking as CMO at HEROCON in June 2026. Ex-Daimler Mobility (digital strategy) and founder of bloXmove — automotive-adjacent, no direct motorsport tie found.

people.name: Sascha Koppe
people.note: Commercial owner across the group's country businesses.

people.name: Philipp Schröder
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still CEO. Was Chief Sales & Marketing Officer at Sonnen and Tesla's Germany country director — a founder who has personally run a marketing function, which matters for a brand-build pitch.

people.name: Torben Diekmann
people.note: Growth remit sits alongside the CRO; relevant where a sponsorship is argued as customer acquisition rather than brand.

companies.note: Checked the company leadership page (antora.com/company): no CMO, VP Marketing or equivalent is listed. The nearest owner of external brand is Adam Frankel, VP Communications and Public Policy — an engineering- and policy-led company, so a sponsorship pitch runs through comms and the co-founder CCO, not a marketing department.

people.name: Adam Frankel
people.note: Closest thing to a marketing owner: holds brand, comms and policy. No CMO exists above him.

people.name: David Bierman
people.note: The real commercial decision-maker — fronts customers, utilities and financiers. Public speaker (Aspen Ideas) so used to platform appearances.

people.name: Andrew Ponec
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still CEO.

companies.note: Checked the company site and careers board: no marketing officer of any level is named publicly. Base Power lists ~12 open Marketing & Community roles including an IC 'Growth Marketing' seat, so the function is being built but has no named head — the approach is Dell direct, or Pianta on the partnerships side.

people.name: Zach Dell
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still CEO. Cheque signer; company valued at $13bn after a $1bn Series D in Aug 2026.

people.name: Justin Lopas
people.note: Runs operations and build-out; ex-SpaceX and Anduril. No secondary company-page confirmation found for the title, hence reported.

people.name: Tim Pianta
people.note: Owns the partnership motion with utilities — the nearest existing partnerships seat in a company with no marketing head.

companies.note: No sitting CMO is named publicly — the last announced CMO was Anthony Deighton in 2018. Marketing sits inside the President's remit: Celonis' own appointment release states Carsten Thoma is responsible for corporate strategy and development, MARKETING, platform ecosystem, culture and Celonis Labs. So the brief's named contact is, unusually, also the marketing owner.

people.name: Carsten Thoma
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still President (appointed Aug 2023; still listed as President on celonis.com/insights/authors/carsten-thoma). Marketing is explicitly in his brief, which makes him both the sponsorship buyer and a senior sponsor — the strongest single entry point of the eleven. Co-founder of Hybris, first external investor in Celonis.

people.name: Miguel Milano
people.note: Owns worldwide revenue; co-owner stake makes him a veto as well as a buyer.

people.name: Alexander Rinke
people.note: Co-CEO with Bastian Nominacher; Munich-headquartered, which fits a European FE calendar.

companies.note: The only company in this batch whose brief already names the marketing owner, and it checks out. Full leadership published at databricks.com/company/leadership-team; EMEA is a named region with its own GM, which matters for a Formula E calendar weighted to Europe and the Middle East.

people.name: Rick Schultz
people.note: Brief's named contact and correct: CMO since 2017, still in seat in 2026. Owns product marketing, demand gen, brand and creative, global comms, events and field marketing — a sponsorship lands squarely in his budget. Ex-SVP Marketing at Alteryx, ex-Oracle.

people.name: Ron Gabrisko
people.note: Worldwide sales and go-to-market; the co-signer on anything pitched as pipeline rather than brand.

people.name: Samuel Bonamigo
people.note: Runs EMEA and was still referenced in that role in the Sep 2025 Benelux/Nordics appointment release — the regional budget holder for European race weekends.

people.name: Ali Ghodsi
people.note: Cheque signer at the top of a company of this size; realistically a ratifier, not the entry point.

companies.note: Checked emeraldai.co/team and emeraldai.co/company: no CMO, VP Marketing or comms lead is listed. A ~2-year-old, research-led company (founded 2024) — the sponsorship conversation is with Sivaram directly, with Padilla as the commercial operator. Do not expect a marketing budget line to exist yet.

people.name: Dr. Varun Sivaram
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still Founder & CEO. Ex-Chief Strategy & Innovation Officer at Ørsted and ex-CTO of ReNew Power — an unusually brand-literate energy executive, and the person who would personally decide a sponsorship.

people.name: Daniel Padilla
people.role: Chief of Staff & Director, Commercial Strategy & Operations
people.note: The commercial operator around the CEO; joined from Rondo Energy. In a company this size, the practical route to Sivaram's diary.

people.name: Prof. Ayse Coskun
people.note: Academic authority on orchestrating data-centre power demand for grid response — the technical counterpart if the pitch is an energy-flexibility workstream with a team's operations rather than a logo.

companies.note: One of only three companies in this batch with a real CMO in seat. EnergyX publishes its executive leadership on energyx.com, and Khalil is named on 2026 press releases (Project Lonestar, the Eni $225M investment, the nuclear-materials platform) — an active, well-funded brand-building programme to sell into.

people.name: Kellee Khalil
people.note: The buyer. Owns business, brand and marketing strategy; with the company since inception and still named on 2026 releases. A serial entrepreneur and brand builder — the profile that responds to a sponsorship narrative rather than a media schedule.

people.name: Chloe Ke
people.role: Executive Vice President, Strategy and Sales
people.note: Nearest thing to a commercial officer — strategy and sales in one seat.

people.name: Teague Egan
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still Founder, Chairman & CEO. Founder-controlled, so he is both cheque signer and veto.

people.name: Amit Patwardhan
people.note: Technical counterpart for any battery-materials or lithium-chemistry workstream with a race team.

companies.note: Checked the management team page on Fervo's investor site (now NASDAQ: FRVO): no CMO or VP Marketing is listed. Communications sits inside the COO's remit — Fervo's own June 2026 release naming Sarah Jewett COO lists supply chain, land, permitting, policy, communications, strategy and people operations under her. So the marketing owner here is the COO, and a public-company disclosure discipline now applies to anything announced.

people.name: Sarah Jewett
people.note: The nearest buyer: communications is explicitly in her remit and no marketing officer exists above her. Newly promoted (10 June 2026) — a fresh mandate is a good moment to land a three-year proposal. Ex-Select Energy Services corporate development, ex-Schlumberger engineer.

people.name: Dawn Owens
people.role: SVP, Head of Development & Commercial Markets
people.note: Owns development and commercial markets since 2020; the counterpart if the pitch is framed around customer and offtake audiences.

people.name: Tim Latimer
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still CEO and a director since 2018. Now runs a listed company, so a sponsorship needs a stated commercial rationale, not a founder's enthusiasm.

companies.note: Checked formenergy.com/about and the team pages: no CMO or VP Marketing. External voice sits with Sarah Bray, VP Communications; the commercial owner is RJ Johnson, SVP Commercial Operations. Engineering- and utility-led, so pitch the sponsorship to Johnson as a utility-audience platform and to Bray as brand.

people.name: Sarah Bray
people.note: Closest to a marketing owner; no CMO exists above her. Title confirmed only via secondary listings of the company team page, hence reported.

people.name: RJ Johnson
people.note: The real commercial decision-maker: utility, commercial and residential storage markets. Has his own page on the company team site.

people.name: Mateo Jaramillo
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still Co-Founder & CEO. Built and ran Tesla's stationary storage business before Form — an automotive-adjacent history that gives a motorsport conversation a foothold.

people.name: Ted Wiley
people.note: President/COO-level co-founder; the second signature on anything multi-year.

companies.note: Checked gatik.ai's about and press-release pages: no CMO, VP Marketing or brand lead is named. The external-facing seat is Richard Steiner (VP, Government Relations & Public Affairs, previously head of policy and communications) and the buyer of a partnership is Paul DiLaura, the Chief Commercial Officer. Gatik's May 2025 leadership build-out added a CFO and a Chief Legal Officer but no marketing officer.

people.name: Paul DiLaura
people.note: In the absence of a CMO, the practical buyer — owns customer-facing commercial strategy and is the company's public commercial voice through 2026 (ACT Expo, freight podcasts).

people.name: Richard Steiner
people.role: Vice President, Government Relations & Public Affairs
people.note: Owns policy and public affairs and previously headed policy and communications; the closest thing to a brand owner in a company with no marketing officer. Fronts broadcast appearances (NBC Today Show).

people.name: Gautam Narang
people.note: Brief's named contact, confirmed still CEO & Co-Founder.

people.name: Arjun Narang
